product.outcome: Read a maker’s post in a newest-first community feed, add a reply, and see the accepted reply under the post it answers.

users.who: A maker checking a chronological community feed on a phone and replying at a desk.

capabilities.note: Replies are persisted under a post; a failed send retains the draft and retries the same reply without duplication.
Publishing creates a post with a stable thread route; drafts are not added to the feed before acceptance.
Following a person or topic changes subsequent chronological feed results; muted topics are excluded.
Saving and unsaving a post updates the member’s Saved list.
A member can delete their own post and its replies after an irreversible confirmation.
Persist audience defaults, reply-email choice, autoplay and muted topics.
Email accepted replies to subscribed authors and push mentions to mentioned members.

homeReady.label: Ready
homeReady.rule: Show complete followed-maker posts newest first; opening Reply takes the member to the post and its replies.

homeLoading.label: Loading
homeLoading.rule: Refresh the chronological feed without reordering the posts already visible.

homeEmpty.label: Empty
homeEmpty.rule: No followed posts have arrived; offer the people-and-topics page, not a publishing error.

homeFailed.label: Failed
homeFailed.rule: The feed request failed; do not claim a member’s post failed to publish.

homeLongContent.label: Long content
homeLongContent.rule: Wrap the reading-group title and full post body while keeping author, date and reply action together.

followingReady.label: Ready
followingReady.rule: Show makers with specialties and follower counts, plus named topic choices; distinguish Follow from Unfollow by membership.

followingLoading.label: Loading
followingLoading.rule: Keep the last loaded maker choices visible while refreshing follow memberships.

followingEmpty.label: Empty
followingEmpty.rule: No follow memberships exist; keep topic suggestions and the search field available.

followingFailed.label: Failed
followingFailed.rule: Following choices could not be loaded; retain existing memberships and retry the read.

followingLongContent.label: Long content
followingLongContent.rule: Wrap a workshop-length maker identity without dropping the specialty or follow control.

popularReady.label: Ready
popularReady.rule: Show posts ranked by this week’s reply activity with reply counts and a route to their threads.

popularLoading.label: Loading
popularLoading.rule: Keep the current weekly discussions visible while retrieving updated reply counts.

popularEmpty.label: Empty
popularEmpty.rule: No discussions qualify this week; offer the chronological Home feed.

popularFailed.label: Failed
popularFailed.rule: Weekly discussion rankings could not be loaded; keep the period choice and retry the read.

popularLongContent.label: Long content
popularLongContent.rule: Allow long discussion titles to wrap; keep each title associated with its own reply count.

savedReady.label: Ready
savedReady.rule: Show posts explicitly saved by this member; opening one restores its original thread.

savedLoading.label: Loading
savedLoading.rule: Keep the saved-post list visible while checking for changes.

savedEmpty.label: Empty
savedEmpty.rule: The member has not saved any posts; return to Home where Save post is available.

savedFailed.label: Failed
savedFailed.rule: Saved posts could not be retrieved; do not imply the saved markers were erased.

savedLongContent.label: Long content
savedLongContent.rule: Wrap saved post titles and bodies without losing their author or thread destination.

postThreadReady.label: Ready
postThreadReady.rule: Read replies oldest first beneath the original maker post; the reply composer addresses that post, not a private inbox.

postThreadLoading.label: Loading
postThreadLoading.rule: Keep the original post visible while loading its replies; do not enable sending until the thread read succeeds.

postThreadEmpty.label: Empty
postThreadEmpty.rule: Show the original post and an empty reply list; invite the first reply in this public thread.

postThreadFailed.label: Failed
postThreadFailed.rule: Keep the original post but replace unavailable replies with a read-retry message; this is not a send failure.

postThreadLongContent.label: Long content
postThreadLongContent.rule: Wrap full bread-proof explanations and workshop-length author names in chronological reply order.

newPostDraft.label: Draft
newPostDraft.rule: Keep the title, body, topic and audience local; no post exists in the feed before Publish post.

newPostSaving.label: Publishing
newPostSaving.rule: Keep the whole post draft visible and disable Publish post while the publish request is pending.

newPostSaved.label: Published
newPostSaved.rule: Replace the editor with the accepted post identity and an Open post route; the post now appears in the chronological feed.

newPostFailed.label: Publication failed
newPostFailed.rule: Publishing was rejected; keep the same title, body, audience and notification choices for a deliberate retry.

newPostLongContent.label: Long post
newPostLongContent.rule: Keep a long reading-group title and detailed maker story fully editable without hiding audience or reply choices.

settingsReady.label: Ready
settingsReady.rule: Show saved audience, reply email and muted-topic preferences; edits remain local until Save preferences.

settingsSaving.label: Saving
settingsSaving.rule: Keep the edited preference values visible and disable duplicate saves until the preference write returns.

settingsSaved.label: Saved
settingsSaved.rule: Show the saved preference values and an inline acknowledgement; reopening this page shows the same choices.

settingsFailed.label: Failed
settingsFailed.rule: Keep edited preference values separate from the last saved values; Save preferences retries the write, Cancel restores the saved choices.

helpReady.label: Ready
helpReady.rule: Keep product help available without replacing the task.

landingReady.label: Ready
landingReady.rule: Present the product explanation and a real route into the app.

emailReplyReceivedReady.label: Ready
emailReplyReceivedReady.rule: Send only after a reply is accepted on the subscribed member’s post; include its title and a direct link to that post’s replies.

pushMentionReceivedReady.label: Ready
pushMentionReceivedReady.rule: Send only after a persisted reply mentions this member; the action opens the referenced post’s reply thread.

homeDeleting.label: Deleting post
homeDeleting.rule: Keep the selected post visible but disable its destructive controls while deletion is pending.

homeDeleted.label: Post deleted
homeDeleted.rule: Remove the accepted deleted post and its replies from the feed; retain an inline confirmation and the remaining newest-first posts.

homeDeleteFailed.label: Deletion failed
homeDeleteFailed.rule: Keep the post and replies visible because deletion was rejected; retry only the same confirmed deletion.

postThreadSending.label: Sending reply
postThreadSending.rule: Keep the reply draft and previous replies visible; disable duplicate sends until the post accepts the reply.

postThreadSent.label: Reply sent
postThreadSent.rule: Append the accepted reply with its author and timestamp, clear only the accepted draft, and retain the post context.

postThreadSendFailed.label: Reply not sent
postThreadSendFailed.rule: Keep the unsent draft separate from accepted replies; retry the same reply without posting a duplicate.

followingSaving.label: Saving follow choice
followingSaving.rule: Keep the maker list visible and disable the changed membership control while the follow write is pending.

followingSaved.label: Follow choice saved
followingSaved.rule: Show the accepted follow membership; subsequent chronological feed reads include that maker’s posts.

followingSaveFailed.label: Follow choice failed
followingSaveFailed.rule: Keep the last accepted membership and explain that the new choice was not saved; retry the same membership change.

homeSavingPost.label: Saving post
homeSavingPost.rule: Keep the selected post visible and disable repeat bookmarking until the save is accepted.

homePostSaved.label: Post saved
homePostSaved.rule: Mark the accepted saved post in the feed and retain a link to Saved where the same discussion can be reopened.

homeSaveFailed.label: Post not saved
homeSaveFailed.rule: Keep the feed visible without a saved marker for the failed request; retry saving that same post.

postThreadRepliesClosed.label: Replies closed
postThreadRepliesClosed.rule: Show the original post and accepted replies, but hide the composer because the author disabled new replies; do not imply a network or send failure.

homePublished.label: New post in feed
homePublished.rule: Place the accepted new post at the top of the chronological feed with its publication time and chosen reply policy; the draft is no longer pending.

postThreadSendEvent.label: Send a reply under this post

newPostInvalidEvent.label: Show missing post title or body

followPersonEvent.label: Follow or unfollow this maker or topic

flows.goal: Read a followed maker’s post and add a reply to its discussion.
flows.ends: The accepted reply appears under the original post with the member’s name and send time; reopening the thread retains it.

flows.goal: Share a maker experiment with a chosen audience.
flows.ends: The post receives a stable thread route and becomes visible in the chronological feed only after publication succeeds.

binding.because: A maker needs room for a post body, topic and audience choice before publishing.

flows.goal: Choose makers and topics for the chronological feed.
flows.ends: Follow membership changes which makers and topics appear on Home; unrelated suggestions do not enter the feed.

flows.goal: Find an active discussion and save it to read again.
flows.ends: The saved discussion is listed in Saved and opens the same post thread.

flows.goal: Choose the default post audience and reply notifications.
flows.ends: Reopening Settings shows the accepted audience, reply-email and muted-topic choices.

flows.goal: Understand reply etiquette and the impact of deleting a post.
flows.ends: The member can distinguish muting a topic from permanently deleting their own discussion.

flows.goal: Decide whether a chronological maker community fits how I read.
flows.ends: The landing action reaches the live chronological feed, not an unimplemented sign-up form.

flows.goal: Read a reply notification and return to the post I wrote.
flows.ends: The email opens the exact discussion containing the accepted reply.

flows.goal: Open the reply where another member mentioned me.
flows.ends: The push action opens the mentioned reply in its original post thread.

surfaces.question: What did the people and topics I follow post?

binding.because: A chosen chronological feed should show each complete post in order.

slots.because: Deleting a maker’s post also removes its replies, so the member must confirm the named post before deletion.
Deletion and bookmarking results remain beside the affected post in the feed, with the actual accepted outcome distinguished.

surfaces.question: Who should I follow, and which topics do I want in my feed?
Which posts have active conversations this week?

binding.because: The person compares discussion titles and reply counts before opening one.

surfaces.question: Which posts did I save to read again?
What was said, and what should I reply?

binding.because: A reply only makes sense beside the maker’s original post; keep its title and body visible above the thread.

slots.because: An accepted reply remains visible in its original thread instead of relying on a disappearing toast.

surfaces.question: What did I make, and who should be able to read and reply to this post?
Who can read my posts, and which replies should notify me?

binding.because: Audience defaults, reply emails and muted topics belong together because they control who appears in a member’s feed and who sees their posts.

surfaces.question: What keeps a discussion useful, and what can I mute?
Can I follow makers without an algorithm reordering their work?
Which post received a reply, and where can I read the conversation?
Which post’s conversation mentions me, and where can I read that reply in context?
